description_en: Queries the session summary by paging for the caller to select or resume existing sessions
description_zh: 分页查询会话摘要，供调用方选择或继续已有会话
kebab_example: aliyun ada list-agent-sessions --params NextToken=next-token-example MaxResults=20 AgentName=review-agent-demo --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAgentSessions

parameters.help_en: The JSON-RPC protocol version. Set this parameter to 2.0
parameters.name: jsonrpc

parameters.help_en: The correlation identifier for this call. This identifier is echoed in the response and does not provide idempotency guarantees
parameters.help_zh: 本次调用的关联标识，响应中回显；不提供幂等保证
parameters.name: id

fields.help_en: Optional. Filters sessions by agent name. The maximum length is 64 characters
fields.help_zh: 可选。按智能体名称筛选会话，最大长度为 64
fields.name: agent_name

fields.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 50. Keep the page size and filter conditions consistent for subsequent pages
fields.help_zh: 每页最大条数，取值范围为 1～100，省略时为 50。续页应保持页大小和筛选条件一致
fields.name: max_results

fields.help_en: The NextToken returned from the previous page. Do not pass this parameter on the first page. In the first phase, the default uses a native opaque cursor. Keep the same filter conditions and pass the token back as is
fields.help_zh: 上一页回包的 NextToken，首页不传；一期 default 使用原生不透明游标，保持相同筛选条件并原样回传
fields.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The business parameter object. The public fields are only AgentName, MaxResults, and NextToken
parameters.help_zh: 业务参数对象。公开字段仅为 AgentName、MaxResults 和 NextToken
parameters.name: params

JsonRpcResponse.description_en: The JSON-RPC response object. The business result is located in Result
JsonRpcResponse.description_zh: JSON-RPC 响应对象，业务结果位于 Result

Id.description_en: The Id from the request, echoed as is
Id.description_zh: 请求里的 Id，原样回显

MaxResults.description_en: The effective page size for the current page

NextToken.description_en: The credential for querying the next page. Pass this value as is to Params.NextToken. Pagination ends when this value is not returned or is empty
NextToken.description_zh: 继续查询下一页的凭证，应原样传入 Params.NextToken。未返回或为空时结束分页

SessionList.description_en: The array of session summaries for the current page. If no matching records are found, an empty array [] is returned. The type is any. The fields of array elements retain the original backend names. For the structure, see the supplementary description of response parameters
SessionList.description_zh: 本页会话摘要数组；无匹配记录时为 []。类型为 any，数组元素字段保留后端原始名称，结构见返回参数补充说明

RequestId.description_en: The server-side request ID used to troubleshoot this call
RequestId.description_zh: 服务端请求 ID，用于排查本次调用
